purpose: Compare one numeric measure across categories or ordered periods.

rawDataContract.notes: Rows can use arbitrary key names.

semanticChannels.semantics: single numeric measure represented by bar height

payloadShape.title: string
payloadShape.financialMarket: CN | HK | US (optional; controls financial up/down colors)

modelInstructions: Use for one primary numeric measure.
For financial direction charts set financialMarket explicitly: CN and HK use red-up/green-down; US uses green-up/red-down. Bars, legends, and tooltips must use the same convention.
Sort periods chronologically and categories by user intent or value when appropriate.
Default x-axis and y-axis tick labels should use 10px font size, matching grouped-bar charts.
Place x-axis labels close to the x-axis baseline; default label baseline offset should be around 20px below the plot area, not the older 26px spacing.
Hide the legend by default for a single-series bar chart because the y-axis description and tooltip already identify the measure. Show it only when legend.visible is explicitly true.
When a legend is explicitly shown, its styling should match grouped-bar charts: 10px text, 8px circular markers, compact row gaps, and labels only.
Tooltip should match grouped-bar charts: compact 10px text, 6px 8px padding, 220px max width, and a vertical gap around 10px.
Show a y-axis description when provided. Use axis.label/description/title/name/axisLabel and place it above the right y-axis ticks.

For right-side y-axes, align the y-axis description to the same right edge as the y-axis tick labels, and allow the description text to extend leftward into the chart area instead of reserving extra right margin.
Right-axis tick labels should be measured and right-aligned close to the plot with a small plot-to-label gap.

X-axis labels should be displayed in full when measured label widths fit without overlap; only sample labels when full display would overlap, and sample by measured text width plus a small gap instead of fixed count rules.
Do not add viewport or screen safety margins inside the component; component padding and default left/right plot margins should be zero unless needed for axis tick labels or explicit user styling.
